# Extending WildFly

> Creating new WildFly subsystem extensions — the extension API, example subsystem, capabilities, JNDI, domain mode transformers, and CLI extensibility.

## Contents

- [Example Subsystem](Example_subsystem.adoc): Step-by-step walkthrough of creating a new WildFly subsystem extension
- [Key Interfaces and Classes](Key_Interfaces_and_Classes_Relevant_to_Extension_Developers.adoc): Extension, SubsystemDefinition, ResourceDefinition, OperationStepHandler, and other key APIs
- [Working with WildFly Capabilities](Working_with_WildFly_Capabilities.adoc): The capability/requirement model for inter-subsystem dependencies
- [WildFly JNDI Implementation](WildFly_JNDI_Implementation.adoc): How WildFly implements JNDI and how extensions interact with it
- [Domain Mode Subsystem Transformers](Domain_Mode_Subsystem_Transformers.adoc): Transforming subsystem resources for mixed-version managed domains
- [CLI Extensibility for Layered Products](CLI_extensibility_for_layered_products.adoc): Adding custom CLI commands for product layers
